title: gongronema wallichii
intro: Gongronema wallichii, commonly known as the African blue basil or Thai basil, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of G. wallichii include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against cell damage.
